decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) an abrupt multi-sample displacement near index 618–622 with sustained offset, and (2) a prolonged segment (~675–709) of complex, possibly superposed cross-axis behavior lacking clear platform or return structure. Other segments show typical noise or smooth motion.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N/E/U (especially N) around index 618–622, followed by a sustained platform at large negative values; the drop appears abrupt and not fully resolved in coarse view, with possible opposing return not yet visible.

Extended region of highly irregular cross-axis motion from ~680 onward: N and E show large-amplitude oscillations while U remains relatively stable; includes ambiguous superposed changes and possible temporary offsets without clear platform or return.
